description:
CLI Dotnet Tool for the Kubernetes Operator SDK.
            Helps with generating CRDs and other elements for the Operator.
releaseNotes:
'## [14.0.0-prerelease.1](https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet-operator-sdk/compare/v13.3.7-prerelease.2...v14.0.0-prerelease.1) (2026-11-11)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **client:** remove JsonPatch.Net and the synchronous client API (#1319)
* **web:** replace LocalTunnel with external webhook endpoints (#1301)
